_readme: Places the report covers. Add or remove entries here; no code changes needed. For a new resort, leave out "snotel" and run: node scripts/find-snotel.mjs JSON can't have comments, so notes live in 'note' / 'todo' fields. Coordinates are decimal degrees (west = negative). Each place has its own IANA timezone.
